scripts.dev: npm run build -w shared && npm run dev -w server
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w shared && npm run typecheck -w server
scripts.db:up: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.db-port.yml up -d db
scripts.test: npm run build -w shared && npm test -w server
